snippet.title: Lightphobe - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Lightphobe, a first-person action asymmetrical team-based PvP game developed by Allan Chew. Players will choose a side and capitalize on cooperation to reign victorious by way of multiple kinds of weapons. Conquer the darkness in Lightphobe, available now for PC (Steam).
